pairs.expectations: Cards for a Brazilian Portuguese reader learning Spanish: every question, option and reveal is in Brazilian Portuguese, with Spanish words only inside quotes.
pairs.defect: The second card (question, all three options and the reveal) is written entirely in Spanish instead of Brazilian Portuguese, so a Brazilian beginner reads a card in the language they have not learned yet.
pairs.falseAllegation: The first card is written in Spanish instead of Brazilian Portuguese.
pairs.provenance: Eval case pt-espanhol output from GPT-6 Luna (synthetic, no learner data), trimmed to three cards; the flawed side rewrites card two in Spanish by hand.
